config.note: Shared summon/promote/sacrifice scene. Pushed with Scene State: ritualMode ('summon'|'promote'|'sacrifice'), targetIsReserve, targetIndex. Page 1 = stats/costs, page 2 = portrait/flavor (Q/E/Tab).

scripts.setupRitual:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
locals._guard = 1
sceneState.state = 1
sceneState.page = 1
sceneState.confirmIdx = 1
sceneState.confirmOptions = { {name = "Yes"}, {name = "No"} }
if sceneState.ritualMode == nil then sceneState.ritualMode = "summon" end
if sceneState.targetIsReserve == nil then sceneState.targetIsReserve = true end
sceneState.targetIndex = sceneState.targetIndex or 1

local function actorEntry(id)
    local pv = api.actorPreview(id)
    local ad = pv and pv.actorData or {}
    return {
        id = id,
        name = pv and pv.name or "?",
        level = ad.level or 1,
        tier = ad.tier or 1,
        spriteKey = ad.smallBattler or ad.spriteKey or "",
        portraitKey = ad.spriteKey or "",
        flavor = ad.flavor or "",
    }
end

if sceneState.ritualMode == "summon" then
    local pool = {}
    for _, actor in ipairs(api.allActors()) do
        if actor.unlocked then table.insert(pool, actorEntry(actor.id)) end
    end
    sceneState.pool = pool
    sceneState.poolIdx = 1
    sceneState._lastPoolIdx = 0
else
    local member = sceneState.targetIsReserve and api.reserve(sceneState.targetIndex) or api.party(sceneState.targetIndex)
    if member and member.empty then member = nil end
    sceneState.memberName = member and member.name or "?"
end
if sceneState.ritualMode == "promote" then
    local member = sceneState.targetIsReserve and api.reserve(sceneState.targetIndex) or api.party(sceneState.targetIndex)
    local paths = {}
    if member and not member.empty then
        for _, e in ipairs((member.actorData and member.actorData.evolutions) or {}) do
            if e.level and member.level >= e.level and e.evolvesTo then
                table.insert(paths, e.evolvesTo)
            end
        end
    end
    sceneState.evoPaths = paths
    sceneState.evoIdx = 1
end
scripts.refreshRitual:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
local sm = api.systemConfig.summoner or {}
local function statWide(p)
    return "HP " .. p.maxHp .. "  ATK " .. p.atk .. "  DEF " .. p.def .. "\nMAT " .. p.mat .. "  MDF " .. p.mdf .. "  ASP " .. p.asp
end
local function statTall(p)
    return "HP  " .. p.maxHp .. "\nATK " .. p.atk .. "\nDEF " .. p.def .. "\nMAT " .. p.mat .. "\nMDF " .. p.mdf .. "\nASP " .. p.asp
end
local function memberSprite(m)
    local ad = m.actorData or {}
    return ad.smallBattler or ad.spriteKey or ""
end

if sceneState.ritualMode == "summon" then
    local entry = sceneState.pool[sceneState.poolIdx]
    if not entry then return end
    if sceneState.poolIdx ~= sceneState._lastPoolIdx then
        sceneState.baseLevel = entry.level
        sceneState.level = entry.level
        sceneState._lastPoolIdx = sceneState.poolIdx
    end
    local pv = api.actorPreview(entry.id, sceneState.level)
    local skills = {}
    for _, s in ipairs(pv.skillList or {}) do table.insert(skills, s.name) end
    sceneState.subjectRow = { { name = entry.name, spriteKey = entry.spriteKey,
        text = entry.name .. "  Lv " .. sceneState.level .. "  (Tier " .. entry.tier .. ")" } }
    sceneState.statText = statWide(pv) .. "\n\nSkills: " .. table.concat(skills, ", ")
    sceneState.mpCost = (sm.summonCostBase or 10) + entry.tier * (sm.summonCostPerTier or 15) + sceneState.level * (sm.summonCostPerLevel or 5)
    sceneState.expCost = api.summonExpCost(entry.id, sceneState.level)
    sceneState.costText = "MP " .. sceneState.mpCost .. "/" .. api.getMp() .. "   EXP " .. sceneState.expCost .. " (Bank " .. api.getExpBank() .. ")\nENTER: summon   ESC: back"
    sceneState.portraitKey = entry.portraitKey
    sceneState.flavorText = entry.name .. "\n\n" .. (entry.flavor or "")
    sceneState.titleText = "SUMMON   E: art   L/R: level   U/D: pick"
elseif sceneState.ritualMode == "promote" then
    local member = sceneState.targetIsReserve and api.reserve(sceneState.targetIndex) or api.party(sceneState.targetIndex)
    if not member or member.empty then
        sceneState.sideText = "No creature."
        sceneState.titleText = "PROMOTE"
        sceneState.costText = "ESC: back"
        return
    end
    local evoId = sceneState.evoPaths and sceneState.evoPaths[sceneState.evoIdx]
    sceneState.sideText = "Choose an\nevolution\npath for\n" .. member.name .. "."
        .. (#(sceneState.evoPaths or {}) > 1 and "\n\nL/R: path" or "")
    if evoId then
        local pv = api.actorPreview(evoId, member.level)
        sceneState.fromRow = { { name = member.name, spriteKey = memberSprite(member), text = member.name } }
        sceneState.toRow = { { name = pv.name, spriteKey = (pv.actorData.smallBattler or pv.actorData.spriteKey or ""), text = pv.name } }
        sceneState.fromStat = "Lv " .. member.level .. "\n" .. statTall(member)
        sceneState.toStat = "Lv " .. member.level .. "\n" .. statTall(pv)
        local ok, costText = api.promoteInfo(sceneState.targetIsReserve, sceneState.targetIndex, sceneState.evoIdx)
        sceneState.costText = "Cost:" .. (costText ~= "" and costText or " (free)") .. "\nENTER: promote   ESC: back"
        sceneState.portraitKey = pv.actorData.spriteKey or ""
        sceneState.flavorText = pv.name .. "\n\n" .. (pv.actorData.flavor or "")
        sceneState.titleText = "PROMOTE   E: art   Path " .. sceneState.evoIdx .. "/" .. #sceneState.evoPaths
    else
        sceneState.fromRow = { { name = member.name, spriteKey = memberSprite(member), text = member.name } }
        sceneState.toRow = { { name = "?", text = "--none--" } }
        sceneState.fromStat = "Lv " .. member.level .. "\n" .. statTall(member)
        sceneState.toStat = "No available\npromotion."
        sceneState.costText = "ESC: back"
        sceneState.portraitKey = (member.actorData or {}).spriteKey or ""
        sceneState.flavorText = ""
        sceneState.titleText = "PROMOTE"
    end
else
    local member = sceneState.targetIsReserve and api.reserve(sceneState.targetIndex) or api.party(sceneState.targetIndex)
    local p = api.sacrificePreview(sceneState.targetIsReserve, sceneState.targetIndex)
    sceneState.titleText = "SACRIFICE   E: art"
    if not p or not member or member.empty then
        sceneState.sideText = "No creature."
        sceneState.costText = "ESC: back"
        return
    end
    sceneState.sideText = "Sacrifice\n" .. member.name .. " to\nbank its EXP\nand receive\nmaterials."
    sceneState.subjectRow = { { name = member.name, spriteKey = memberSprite(member),
        text = member.name .. "  Lv " .. member.level } }
    local lines = { "EXP Yield: " .. p.exp .. "   (Bank: " .. api.getExpBank() .. ")" }
    for _, r in ipairs(p.rewards or {}) do
        table.insert(lines, r.name .. " x" .. r.count .. "  (" .. math.floor((r.chance or 1) * 100) .. "%)")
    end
    sceneState.statText = statWide(member) .. "\n\n" .. table.concat(lines, "\n")
    sceneState.costText = "ENTER sacrifice  ESC back"
    sceneState.portraitKey = (member.actorData or {}).spriteKey or ""
    sceneState.flavorText = member.name .. "\n\n" .. ((member.actorData or {}).flavor or "")
end
scripts.stepLevel:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
if sceneState.ritualMode ~= "summon" or sceneState.state ~= 1 then return end
local entry = sceneState.pool and sceneState.pool[sceneState.poolIdx]
if not entry then return end
local dir = sceneState._stepDir or 0
local newLevel = (sceneState.level or 1) + dir
if newLevel < (sceneState.baseLevel or 1) then newLevel = sceneState.baseLevel or 1 end
if newLevel > 99 then newLevel = 99 end
if dir > 0 and api.summonExpCost(entry.id, newLevel) > api.getExpBank() then
    return
end
sceneState.level = newLevel
scripts.confirmRitual:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
locals._guard = 1
if sceneState.ritualMode == "summon" then
    local entry = sceneState.pool[sceneState.poolIdx]
    local target = sceneState.targetIsReserve and api.reserve(sceneState.targetIndex) or api.party(sceneState.targetIndex)
    if target and not target.empty then
        sceneState.resultText = "That slot is occupied!"
        sceneState.state = 1
    elseif api.getMp() < (sceneState.mpCost or 0) then
        sceneState.resultText = "Not enough MP!"
        sceneState.state = 1
    elseif api.getExpBank() < (sceneState.expCost or 0) then
        sceneState.resultText = "Not enough banked EXP!"
        sceneState.state = 1
    else
        api.changeMp(-(sceneState.mpCost or 0))
        api.changeExpBank(-(sceneState.expCost or 0))
        api.summon(entry.id, sceneState.targetIsReserve, sceneState.targetIndex, sceneState.level)
        sceneState.resultText = "Summoned " .. entry.name .. "\nat Lv " .. tostring(sceneState.level) .. "!"
        sceneState.state = 3
    end
elseif sceneState.ritualMode == "promote" then
    local ok = api.promote(sceneState.targetIsReserve, sceneState.targetIndex, sceneState.evoIdx)
    if ok then
        sceneState.resultText = tostring(sceneState.memberName) .. " evolved\ninto a stronger form!"
        sceneState.state = 3
    else
        sceneState.resultText = "Promotion failed\n(cost not met)."
        sceneState.state = 1
    end
else
    if not sceneState.targetIsReserve and api.partyCount() <= 1 then
        sceneState.resultText = "Cannot sacrifice your\nlast creature!"
        sceneState.state = 1
    else
        local r = api.executeSacrifice(sceneState.targetIsReserve, sceneState.targetIndex)
        if r then
            local txt = "Sacrificed " .. r.name .. "!\n+" .. r.exp .. " EXP banked."
            for _, it in ipairs(r.items or {}) do
                txt = txt .. "\nGot " .. it.name .. " x" .. it.count .. "!"
            end
            sceneState.resultText = txt
            sceneState.state = 3
        else
            sceneState.resultText = "Nothing to sacrifice."
            sceneState.state = 1
        end
    end
end
if sceneState.state == 1 then
    sceneState.costText = sceneState.resultText:gsub("\n", " ") .. "   ESC: back"
end

on_up.condition: locals._guard == 0 and sceneState.state == 1 and sceneState.ritualMode == 'summon' and sceneState.poolIdx > 1

on_down.condition: locals._guard == 0 and sceneState.state == 1 and sceneState.ritualMode == 'summon' and sceneState.poolIdx < #sceneState.pool

on_left.condition: locals._guard == 0 and sceneState.state == 1 and sceneState.ritualMode == 'promote' and #sceneState.evoPaths > 1

on_right.condition: locals._guard == 0 and sceneState.state == 1 and sceneState.ritualMode == 'promote' and #sceneState.evoPaths > 1

content.text: {sceneState.state == 2 and 'ENTER: confirm   ESC: cancel' or (sceneState.state == 3 and 'ENTER: close' or sceneState.titleText)}
